title: console: a screen flow dialog over a record page falls back to its first screen on any route change (browser Back/Forward), because the host keeps only the run's launch state
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Filing gate: ① a defect found by the dev of #36849 (report on that card, `out_of_scope_findings`), read from code, not reproduced; filed by the seat (dev agents never file cards). Untriaged: grade, domain and state are triage's.

## What happens (read from code)

`RecordDetailView` keeps only a screen flow run's LAUNCH state (the step the run first paused on); every later step lives inside `FlowRunner`. The record page's loading-reset effect on `objectName` / record id draws a skeleton through an early return, which unmounts `FlowRunner`; when it mounts again it is rebuilt from the launch state — step one, its inputs and a live Next. Next then posts step one's values to a run already past it and gets the engine's 400 "Invalid screen input".

PR #36947 (#36849) closes the case the card reported — following a record link on a result screen now ends the dialog first. Any OTHER route change while a multi-step wizard sits on step 2+ over a record page still shows step one again: browser Back/Forward, or a navigation not made through the dialog.

## Expected

A screen flow dialog never falls back to an earlier screen of a run that has moved past it: either the host keeps the run's current step across its own remounts, or the dialog ends on a route change it did not make.

## Pointers

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx` (header section "Following a record link ends the dialog"), the record page host (`RecordDetailView`, its loading-reset early return), #36864 (lost-resume recovery, related), #36849 / PR #36947.

Dedupe: `FlowRunner remount launch state`, `RecordDetailView isLoading early return`, `screen flow browser back step one` — no open card found.
